newsitem.title: USA: SeaEscape ends financing, reorganization plans.
newsitem.headline: SeaEscape ends financing, reorganization plans.

text.p: New SeaEscape Cruises Inc said Friday it had completed its financing plan as well as the reorganization of the company.
A company spokesman said Belair Financial Services Inc, an investment company, had provided the final financing for it.
He said the company would use the money to help promote a new luxury cruise ship it bought last year. He declined to disclose the amount of money the financing entailed.
SeaEscape has been operating short international cruises to Freeport and party cruises from South Florida for more than 15 years.
